title: Lost Between the Clouds
description: Create Aeronautics, add-ons, and floating islands.
body:
A quick mod-pack, originally made for just me and my friends, but ultimately published for easy sharing.

It features Create Aeronautics, as well as many Create add-ons, all placed on top of floating sky island world generation.

I've only done performance and compatability testing, this could be easy, or it could be impossible... [If you spawn in the void, you need to make a new world with a new seed, or cheat the worldspawn to the nearest island]

If any of the mod creators wish for their mod to be removed from this list, I will do so.
